title: 第633章 莫问天成了软柿子第632章 天庭映照天路将显
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
见莫问天主动退让认输。
方才暗中煽风点火的各方妖魔势力见状，尽数闭上嘴不再拱火。
心中虽然遗憾未能让莫问天上当，却也悄悄松了口气。
莫问天不肯应战，在他们眼中等同于莫问天没有把握快速拿下厉自在，足以证明他的修为没有达到八境之巅，不然何须退让。
想到此处，一些人心中有了想法。
妖魔群中一位黑袍神秘之人，低沉声音悄然从口中传出，是成熟女子之声，带着霸气命令道：“天路之上，将他淘汰。”
黑袍神秘女子身后，一位尸气惊人，已达到八境之巅的尸修，垂头微躬，领命道：“遵命。”
不仅仅是黑袍神秘女子这般。
还有一些势力，也纷纷派出宗门二三号选手，去提前淘汰莫问天，免得被天命之子在机缘之争中渔翁得利占了便宜。
......
天路阵印，终于在万众瞩目中彻底成型。
“嗡！！！”
二十道震彻八荒的道鸣响彻云霄，二十道阵纹骤然迸发璀璨光华，齐齐向外膨胀延展。
化作二十座广袤无垠的圆形光台，悬浮于大地之上。
这便是二十四名额争夺之地，唯有决出胜负，二十四名额彻底锁定，天路才会真正现世。
刹那间，暗流涌动。
所有觊觎天庭机缘的人物，眼神一凝，眼底蛰伏的野心与执念，纷纷浮现。
龙舟上，一位身姿卓越的宫装女子来到夜洐身边，她衣袂华贵、仪态凛然，自带三分帝袍女子的风华，尤其是那双凌冽霸气的凤眸，与帝袍女子如出一辙。
宫装女子，正是帝袍女子附身之人。
“走吧。”

帝袍女子带着莫问天，踏出龙舟，朝着最近的两座天路阵台而去。
与此同时，天地各方势力，皆有八境强者破空而出。
就连人山人海的大地中，都有数道不凡气势的散修踏出。
瞬息之间，近百位八境强者，尽数落在二十四座天路阵台之外，分散四方，互相对峙，气氛凝重。
但无人率先进入天路阵台。
大家都保持警惕，眼神锐利扫过其他竞争者。
敢参与天路之阵，自然了解其规则，知晓二十四个名额，自身实力极其重要，但选择同样重要。
二十四道天路阵台。
若是两位八境数一数二的人物，都选中同一座天路阵台，那必有一人惨遭淘汰，哪怕被淘汰之人比其他得到名额之人更强，也无用。
正因为如此，大家都在观望。
都不愿意先选择，先进入者，便失去了选择主动权，只能被动等待其他竞争者的选择。
谁都想选择，竞争者最小，竞争者偏弱的天路阵台。
近百位强者隔空对峙，无声博弈。
空气凝重到几乎凝固。
大家目光交错，暗暗自打量、甄别对手。
夜洐也打量众人，很多他都不认识，更有不少人身裹厚重黑袍，从头到尾遮掩身形样貌，雌雄难辨。
夜洐没有在人群中，发现厉邪姒的六道次身，想来她也是隐藏了自身。
一时间，全场陷入诡异的僵持中。
“诸位，天路阵台开启时间仅有一炷香，时限已到，便再无入局机会。”有人开口提醒。
可即便如此，依旧无人妄动。

“靠小聪明投机取巧，侥幸得了名额又如何？亦不配染指机缘。”突然，一道清冷孤傲，霸气绝伦的女子声音从天穹落下。
一道白衣倩影踏空而来，身姿飘逸绝尘，宛若九天谪仙。
content_en:
Seeing that Mo Wentian took the initiative to give in and admit defeat.
When the demonic forces from all sides who had been secretly fanning the flames saw this, they all shut their mouths and stopped fanning the flames.
Although he felt regretful that he could not be fooled by Mo Wentian, he also breathed a sigh of relief.
Mo Wentian's refusal to accept the challenge was, in their eyes, equivalent to the fact that Mo Wentian was not confident of quickly capturing Li Zizai, which proved that his cultivation had not reached the top of the Eighth Realm, otherwise there would be no need to give in.
Thinking of this, some people have ideas in their minds.
A mysterious man in black robes among the group of demons quietly came out from his mouth with a low voice. It was the voice of a mature woman. He commanded with domineering power: "Kill him out on the road to heaven."
Behind the mysterious woman in black robes, a corpse cultivator with astonishing corpse energy, who had reached the top of the Eighth Realm, lowered his head and bowed slightly, receiving the order: "I obey."
It's not just the mysterious woman in black robe.
There are also some forces that have also sent the second and third players of the sect to eliminate Mo Wentian in advance, so as not to be taken advantage of by the Son of Destiny in the battle of opportunity.
...
The Heavenly Road Formation Seal finally took shape under the spotlight.
“Buzz!!!”
Twenty Dao sounds that shook the entire world resounded through the sky, and twenty array patterns suddenly burst out with bright brilliance, all expanding outwards.
It turned into twenty vast circular light platforms, suspended above the earth.
This is the place where the twenty-four spots are competed for. Only when the winner is determined and the twenty-four spots are completely locked, will the road to heaven truly appear.
In an instant, an undercurrent surged.
All the characters who coveted the opportunity in heaven focused their eyes, and the dormant ambitions and obsessions in their eyes emerged one after another.
On the dragon boat, an outstanding-looking woman in palace attire came to Ye Hui. She was luxuriously dressed and dignified in manners. She had the elegance of a woman in imperial robes, especially her pair of sharp and domineering phoenix eyes, which were exactly the same as the woman in imperial robes.
The woman in palace robes is the one possessed by the woman in imperial robes.
"Let's go."
The woman in imperial robes took Mo Wentian out of the dragon boat and headed towards the two nearest Tianlu formations.
At the same time, from all forces in the world, powerful men from the Eight Realms emerged from the sky.
Even in the huge crowds of people, there are several casual cultivators stepping out with extraordinary momentum.
In an instant, nearly a hundred eight-level experts fell outside the twenty-four Heavenly Path formations, scattered in all directions, confronting each other, and the atmosphere was solemn.
But no one entered the Tianlu Formation first.
Everyone was alert, their eyes sharply scanning the other competitors.
If you dare to participate in the Tianlu Formation, you will naturally understand its rules and know the twenty-four places. Your own strength is extremely important, but your choice is equally important.
Twenty-four Heavenly Path Formations.
If two people who are among the best in the Eight Realms choose the same Heavenly Path Formation, then one of them will be eliminated. Even if the person eliminated is stronger than the other people who got the spot, it will be useless.
Because of this, everyone is waiting and watching.
No one is willing to choose first. The first entrant loses the initiative to choose and can only passively wait for the choices of other competitors.
Everyone wants to choose the Tianlu Formation with the smallest and weakest competitors.
Nearly a hundred strong men faced each other in the air, playing a silent game.
The air was so heavy that it was almost solid.
Everyone's eyes crossed each other, secretly sizing up and identifying their opponents.
Ye Hui also looked at everyone, many of whom he didn't recognize, and many of them were wrapped in thick black robes, covering their appearance from head to toe, making it difficult to tell whether they were male or female.
Ye Hao was not in the crowd and discovered Li Xiesi's six-dimensional reincarnation. Presumably, she also hid herself.
For a moment, the entire audience fell into a strange stalemate.
"Everyone, the Tianlu Formation can only be opened for one stick of incense. The time limit has expired, and there is no chance to enter the game." Someone reminded.
But even so, no one acted rashly.
"So what if I got the spot by luck because of my cleverness and opportunism? I don't deserve the chance." Suddenly, a cold, aloof, domineering female voice fell from the sky.
A beautiful figure in white came out of the sky, her figure was elegant and dusty, like an immortal banished from the Nine Heavens.
